<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>ANcpLua.Agents.Evaluation</id>
    <version>2.0.1</version>
    <authors>Alexander Nachtmann</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/ANcpLua/ANcpLua.Agents</projectUrl>
    <description>Fail-closed evaluation suite for Microsoft Agent Framework. One fluent builder composes deterministic local checks, LLM-judged quality, and any IAgentEvaluator stage over a single agent run, then ends in a gate that cannot silently pass.</description>
    <tags>agent evaluation eval gate ci microsoft-agents llm-judge</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/ANcpLua/ANcpLua.Agents" branch="refs/heads/main" commit="bec4a3ff0aa9bad1c7093d97f99ca38362cbb158" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Agents.AI" version="1.13.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Agents.AI.Abstractions" version="1.13.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation" version="10.8.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI" version="10.8.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.8.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
